QUOTE: Handlers never call `database.write` themselves. Most go through `handleRecords` or `processRecords`/`prepareRecords`, and some call `this.batchRecords` directly

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer says every write funnels through `batchRecords` in `BaseDataOperator`. It never says this holds because each mixin is constrained to extend `ServerDataOperatorBase`. It says the mixins wrap the previous class as subclasses, but does not name that constraint as the reason.
